description: Runs the shell's parser in check mode on every startup file.
name: Shell configuration syntax

description: Directories listed more than once in the PATH of a fresh login shell.
name: Duplicate PATH entries

description: PATH entries that point to directories which do not exist.
name: Missing PATH directories

description: Empty, relative or world-writable PATH entries that can make commands resolve unexpectedly.
name: Suspicious PATH entries

description: Symbolic links in PATH directories whose target no longer exists (leftovers of uninstalled tools).
name: Broken command links in PATH

description: `source` statements in startup files pointing to files that are gone.
name: Sourced files that do not exist

description: Startup files that source each other in a loop.
name: Recursive sourcing

description: The same file sourced more than once at startup (typically an installer appended its line twice).
name: Duplicate source statements

description: Shell aliases that replace common developer commands (python, pip, node, git...).
name: Aliases shadowing commands

description: Tool variables (NVM_DIR, PYENV_ROOT, JAVA_HOME, ANDROID_HOME...) that point to directories which do not exist.
name: Environment variables pointing nowhere

description: Messages your startup files print each time a terminal opens: command not found, missing files, insecure completion directories.
name: Errors printed at terminal startup

description: Measures how long a new login shell takes to start and, for zsh, which startup lines are responsible.
name: Terminal startup time

description: Several Python installations, and `python` vs `python3` resolving to different interpreters.
name: Python interpreters

description: `pip` installs packages into a different Python than the interpreter you run.
name: pip / python mismatch

description: Node.js installed through several tools (Homebrew, nvm, fnm, Volta, installer...).
name: Node.js installations

description: `npm` belongs to a different Node installation than `node`.
name: npm / node mismatch

description: `npm install -g` writes into a directory you do not own (the classic EACCES error that people fix with sudo).
name: npm global install permissions

description: After switching Node versions with nvm, fnm, asdf or mise, global packages (and their commands) stay behind in the old version.
name: Global npm packages left in another Node version

description: Claude Code present both as the native install (~/.local/bin/claude) and as the npm package, or in several Node versions.
name: Claude Code installed more than once

description: rustup is installed but its bin directory is not in PATH, so cargo and rustc are not reachable.
name: Cargo bin directory in PATH

description: git, clang, make and Homebrew need the Command Line Tools; checks they are installed and that xcode-select points to an existing directory.
name: Xcode Command Line Tools

description: Installation prefix, PATH visibility, broken links and duplicated versioned formulae.
name: Homebrew health

description: Runs `brew doctor` (slow) and reports each warning.
name: brew doctor

description: Dev servers and scripts whose terminal is gone or whose project directory no longer exists.
name: Stale development processes

description: Common development ports (3000, 5173, 8000, ...) currently held by dev servers.
name: Occupied development ports

description: Size of the Homebrew download cache.
name: Homebrew cache size

description: Size of npm's content-addressed cache.
name: npm cache size

description: Size of pip's wheel/HTTP cache.
name: pip cache size

description: Disk used by Ollama models, including models not used for a long time.
name: Ollama models

description: Size of uv's package and build cache.
name: uv cache size

description: Python virtualenvs whose interpreter no longer exists (Python was upgraded or removed).
name: Broken virtual environments

description: Large node_modules folders in projects untouched for six months or more.
name: node_modules of inactive projects

description: Private keys or ~/.ssh readable by other users (ssh refuses such keys).
name: SSH file permissions

description: ~/.ssh/config entries that reference missing identity files or duplicate hosts.
name: SSH configuration

description: Missing user.name / user.email and dangling paths in the global Git configuration.
name: Git identity and global config

description: Services registered with `brew services` that start at login.
name: Homebrew services

description: User launch agents whose program is missing or that keep failing.
name: Broken launch agents
